admission_note: program/tools.json and scripts/tool_api.py are root-owned. Root admits the single descriptor below (operation plan|packet is the MCP surface; one tool because MCP prompt names come from the skill directory); run/resume stay just/CLI actions because they are long and mutating. The tool_api.py dispatch text is in the lane handoff root_owned_changes_requested.
refusal_transport: exit 2 with one JSON object on stderr: {status: refused, reason: <code>, message}

cli_only.run: python3 scripts/take_intake.py run SOURCE --capture-interval START END --capture-review TEXT [--interval-reviewed-includes-setup] [--family ID] [--arrangement PATH --anchor-seconds S --anchor-source TEXT --clicks-per-grid-period 1|2] [--bpm X] [--features base|extended] [--analysis-python PATH] [--origin real_recording|synthetic_fixture] [--state-root DIR]

tools.name: take_intake
tools.title: Second-take intake: plan and evidence packet
tools.description: operation plan: read-only intake plan for a NEW take (source sha256, ffprobe summary, deterministic take_family_id that never collides with the October 5 family, corpus row draft with split null, ordered stages with exact argv, required operator inputs). operation packet: path-free evidence packet for a finished or partial intake (stage denominators, hashes, signal versions, tool versions, capture record, phrase timing offsets with direction withheld_uncalibrated, claim classes, unknowns) plus a closed-schema TIN-5186 draft carrying only the family id and non-media metadata (V6), never sent by the tool. The long mutating run/resume stays a just/CLI action.
tools.intent: Show exactly what a new-take intake will run and which inputs only the operator can supply, then give root and the operator a reviewable, path-free account of the result before anything is reported to XORuby.

operation.description: plan: read-only intake plan for SOURCE (writes nothing). packet: rebuild evidence-packet.json and the TIN-5186 draft (draft_not_sent) inside an intake directory.

source.description: Existing local recording; must not be a symlink, inside artifacts/runs, or a tracked/unignored repository path. Never written.

family.description: Optional explicit take_family_id (corpus.IDENTIFIER); default is take-<16 hex> derived from the source sha256.

arrangement.description: Optional arrangement reference bound to THIS source sha256; program/demo-arrangement.json belongs to the first take and is refused.

bpm.description: Optional approximate operator pulse; not an intended score.

features.description: run_demo feature set the plan describes; phrase_anchor needs extended clicks.

origin.description: Corpus row origin for the draft.

intake_dir.description: Intake run directory written by take_intake run (<state-root>/<family>/<intake_id>/ holding intake.json). A pipeline artifacts/runs directory is refused (not_an_intake_run_dir).

timeout_seconds.description: Hard owned-worker deadline in seconds; plan hashes the source and runs ffprobe, packet re-hashes recorded outputs.

limitations: Probe fields are ffprobe declarations; nothing is decoded or listened to.
The family id is a truncated domain-separated hash of the source sha256; the same bytes at any path give the same id.
split stays null (pending_operator_choice); the admissibility check only shows the row validates once a split is chosen.
Plans never assign a split, author an arrangement reference, adopt a default or verify that a capture interval is noise-only.
Writes evidence-packet.json and tin-5186-message-draft.json inside the intake directory only; status draft_not_sent.
The draft holds no media, no 64-hex hashes, no src_/art_ ids, no source-timed spans, no capture values, no review text, no file names and no host paths.
Phrase timing is measured signed offsets only; ahead/behind direction stays withheld_uncalibrated. No note-correctness or missed-note verdict.
Everything audible stays needs_listening; packets adopt no detector, profile or master.

dependencies.note: packet requires an intake directory produced by just take-run; review the capture interval on /sources/[id]/capture or with just review before take-run.

agent_workflow.identify: Confirm this is a new take (not the October 5 source), read the required operator inputs, and for packets confirm the run manifest binding is bound.
agent_workflow.research: Read docs/spec/sprints/TAKE_INTAKE_S3.md and the operator ruling of 2026-10-07; the first 5.0 s are setup and never auto-confirmed noise; every analysis must declare the current denoised.wav.
agent_workflow.iterate: Plan again after the operator supplies a reference, anchor or BPM (plans are byte-identical for identical inputs); rebuild packets after a resume and never edit them by hand.
agent_workflow.acceptance: Neither a plan nor a packet establishes restoration quality, phrase correctness, note correctness or listening acceptance; root sends the TIN-5186 draft only after operator review.

cross_field_rules.packet: requires intake_dir; rejects source, family, arrangement, bpm, features and origin
